ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity dominant; estimated white-to-black pixel ratio <0.05 across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform black pigmentation (low-intensity); small localized white/grey mottled speckles visible on the lower-right quadrant and scattered along the lower boundary of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle of approximately 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both lobes; includes a prominent deep trapezoidal indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature with strong upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular white high-contrast pixels located primarily on the lower ventral surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent diagonal linear scar (rake mark) extending from the upper-mid region of the left lobe toward the lower-left trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major traumatic excision (missing chunk) on the trailing edge of the right lobe; distinct linear diagonal abrasion on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of the deep, non-median trapezoidal notch on the right lobe and the high-contrast diagonal rake mark on the left lobe serves as a unique visual fingerprint.
